# Moonleaf

> Moonleaf is a free Android app (Android 7.0+) that saves web novels and fan fiction from Royal Road, Scribble Hub, FanFiction.net, AO3, Standard Ebooks, RoliaScan and Indra Translations as EPUB files on the phone and reads them, or any EPUB the user already has, in a built-in reader inspired by KOReader. No account, no ads, no analytics; the library stays on the device. Distributed as an APK from GitHub, not Google Play.

## Key facts

- Price: free. No ads, no in-app purchases, no account.
- Platform: Android 7.0 or later. APK download of about 145 MB. iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux builds are possible from source but not published.
- Supported sources: Royal Road, Scribble Hub, FanFiction.net and FictionPress (pages load in an in-app browser; the user may need to complete a Cloudflare human check), AO3 and Standard Ebooks (the site's own EPUB is downloaded), RoliaScan and Indra Translations. Indra Translations supports publicly readable chapters; premium or login-only chapters stop the download with an access message. Text only, not image-only manga. Any EPUB file can also be imported. Wattpad is not supported because its terms prohibit scraping.
- What it does: paste a story's URL or a link to any chapter; Moonleaf adds it to the library and downloads the whole book automatically as an EPUB, with chapter names tidied to "Chapter N: Name". Reading can start as soon as the first chapter arrives; a link to a later chapter downloads from there first and marks the earlier chapters read. Downloads continue in the background with a progress notification, and links can be shared to Moonleaf from a browser. The novel page lists chapters Mihon-style (read chapters dimmed, tap to open, Resume). "Check for new chapters" checks only the newest chapter for a Next link and adds any new ones; the EPUB can be saved for other apps.
- App updates: Settings → App Updates compares the installed version with verified release metadata on moonleaf.cjservin.com, shows release notes, and downloads the APK inside the app with progress, cancellation and retry. Tap Install Update to open Android’s normal confirmation prompt. Checks are on request; installation is never silent. Published release APKs use a permanent signing key, so future signed releases keep app data when installed over each other. Builds 48 and earlier used temporary debug keys and require one final reinstall to move to signed releases. Save EPUBs outside the app first; uninstalling removes local progress, highlights, settings and library data. Updates are installed manually.
- Reader features: paged or continuous view; font (including custom TTF/OTF), size, weight, line/word/letter spacing, indent, paragraph spacing, margins, justification; page colors Paper, Sepia, Sage, Dusk, Night, E-ink and E-ink dark; an e-ink mode (automatic on Hisense, Boox, Kobo and similar devices) that removes animations and flashing; configurable tap zones, swipe, pinch-to-zoom text, and page turns with the volume buttons, keyboards, page-turner remotes or media keys; screen reader (TalkBack) support; configurable status bar; contents with page numbers; bookmarks; highlights with notes in several colors; full-text search; go to page or percent; footnote previews; Read Aloud (sentence by sentence with highlighting and automatic page turns, screen-off playback with notification controls, the phone's text-to-speech or a free 42 MB offline AI voice); hold a word to see its definition (Wiktionary, or a built-in WordNet dictionary offline), with the definition read aloud on request; Wikipedia and translation look-ups in the browser; reading statistics and time-left estimates.
- Library: tabs for Library (cover grid or list with Plan to read / Reading / Completed shelves), Updates (downloads and new chapters, check all books at once), Reading (continue reading, recently opened, finished), Settings and Search. The design follows Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, fits phones down to 320 points wide and supports very large text and reduced motion.
- Privacy: all data (library, EPUBs, positions, highlights, statistics) is stored on the device. The app connects to the novel sites the user chooses, to Wiktionary when a word is held for its definition, and to GitHub when the optional natural voice is downloaded.
- Affiliation: independent project, not affiliated with KOReader, Mihon, Royal Road, Scribble Hub, FanFiction.net, AO3, Standard Ebooks, RoliaScan or Indra Translations, and contains no code from KOReader or Mihon.
